name: Get Sample IOCs
description: Get the indicators of compromise (URLs, domains, IPs, files, ...) VMRay found for a sample — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Submission Result or Get Samples By Hash.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Get Submission Result. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

ioc_severity_filter.description: Restrict which IOC severities are fetched from VMRay. Allowed values: 'malicious', 'suspicious'. Add exactly one to filter server-side; leave empty (or add both) to fetch both severities. A list with no valid value is an error.
ioc_severity_filter.title: IOC severity filter

found.description: True when VMRay returned at least one IOC.
found.title: Found

sample_id.description: The sample the data belongs to.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

ioc_count.description: How many IOCs there are in all categories.
ioc_count.title: Ioc Count

ioc_counts.description: How many IOCs there are per category.
ioc_counts.title: Ioc Counts

iocs.description: The IOCs as VMRay returns them, by category (urls, domains, ips, files, mutexes, ...).
iocs.title: Iocs
